display.purpose: Fraunces at weight 800, opsz 144, WONK 1. Section titles and fruit names. WONK's alternate letterforms turn to mush under about 1.5rem, so anything smaller must switch to the label axes.

headline.purpose: Fraunces at display axes, one step down. Sub-heads inside a section.

body.purpose: Chivo 400 at 1.6 leading, capped at 66ch. Everything the visitor actually reads.

label.purpose: Chivo 600, uppercase, 0.09em tracking. Nav links, eyebrows, field labels.

button.purpose: Chivo 600 at body size, line-height 1. Never Fraunces: the button label sits under 1.5rem where WONK breaks down.

shadows.name: lift
shadows.purpose: Resting depth for cards and photos on the cream page. Two layers, always offset plus blur.

shadows.name: raise
shadows.purpose: Hover state of a lifted surface.

shadows.name: press
shadows.purpose: Pressed state; the surface sits back down onto the paper.

shadows.name: deep
shadows.purpose: Same two-layer shape mixed darker, for surfaces sitting on a green band where the paper shadows vanish.

shadows.name: deep-raise
shadows.purpose: Hover state on a green band.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Exponential: fast start, long settle. Reads as released rather than driven. The site's default for anything entering.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: Symmetric easing for state changes: colour, border, small transforms.

motion.name: duration-fast
motion.purpose: Press feedback and other movement the visitor should not notice.

motion.name: duration
motion.purpose: Default for hover and focus transitions.

motion.name: duration-slow
motion.purpose: Scroll reveals driven by IntersectionObserver adding a class.

components.name: Primary Button

components.name: Navigation Link
components.description: Uppercase Chivo on the green header. The underline is a separate bar growing from the left, not text-decoration, which cannot animate from zero and cuts descenders.
components.html: AcasăContact
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: var(--space-m); padding: var(--space-s) var(--space-m); background: var(--forest); } .ds-nav-link { position: relative; display: inline-block; padding-block: var(--space-3xs); color: var(--on-dark); font-family: var(--font-text); font-size: var(--step--1); font-weight: var(--weight-mid); letter-spacing: var(--tracking-label); text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; text-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(33, 48, 26, 0.6); transition: color var(--duration) var(--ease); } .ds-nav-link::after { content: ""; position: absolute; inset-inline: 0; bottom: 0; height: 2px; background: var(--action); transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: left center; transition: transform var(--duration) var(--ease); } .ds-nav-link:hover::after, .ds-nav-link--on::after { transform: scaleX(1); } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--action); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Consent Checkbox
components.description: Privacy consent row under the contact form. Checkbox tinted with the darkened orange so it stays legible on cream.
components.css: .ds-consent { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: var(--space-2xs); } .ds-consent-check { flex: none; width: 1.125rem; height: 1.125rem; margin: 0.3em 0 0; accent-color: var(--action-deep); } .ds-consent-check:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--action); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-consent-label { max-width: 42ch; color: var(--ink-soft); font-family: var(--font-text); font-size: var(--step--1); line-height: var(--leading-body); }

components.name: Photo Card
components.description: The generous radius is deliberate: photos should read as objects laid on the page, not holes cut into it.

narrative.northStar: Cream Ground, Photos Are The Colour
narrative.overview:
The page is cream and the photographs supply the colour. Five creams carry every ground from raised card to plate, and a single green appears exactly three times: the hero wash, the header fill after scroll, and the footer. The four fruits are not four palettes; their colour lives in the photography, not in the interface.

One orange is the only action colour, and it means clickable and nothing else. Text is brown rather than dark green, which keeps the green free to be a ground instead of competing as type. There is no white token anywhere on the site; the lightest cream stands in for it on small raised surfaces.

Type is Fraunces for display and Chivo for everything read. Depth is quiet and always two-layered, offset plus blur, because blur alone reads as a halo rather than a shadow. Motion is exponential and long-settling, so things feel released rather than driven.
keyCharacteristics: Five creams, one green, one orange. Nothing else earns a band.
No white token exists; --paper-lift (#FAF9EF) is the closest thing to one.
The green #698240 carries three token names and has no dark variant on purpose.
Orange means clickable, everywhere, without exception.
Photographs get a generous 14px radius so they sit on the page rather than punch through it.
Every shadow is two layers, offset plus blur, never blur alone.
Type scale is fluid clamp() capped at 6rem, past which a fruit name reads as wallpaper.

rules.name: The One Action Colour Rule
rules.body: Orange (#E87614) means clickable. It is never a decorative fill, never a band ground, and nothing clickable is any other colour.

rules.name: The Touching Creams Rule
rules.body: --paper (#F6F1E1) and --cream (#F4EDDB) sit only 1.03 apart in contrast. They must never meet edge to edge; put a rule, a plate, or a photograph between them.

rules.name: The No White Rule
rules.body: There is no white token on this site. Reach for --paper-lift and only on small raised surfaces.

rules.name: The Sky Rule
rules.body: --sky (#AECBE1) is an accent and never a band ground. Pale blue under a green page reads as a different site.

rules.name: The WONK Threshold Rule
rules.body: Fraunces WONK 1 gives alternate letterforms that turn to mush under about 1.5rem. Anything smaller switches to --axes-label (opsz 24, WONK 0).

rules.name: The Two-Layer Shadow Rule
rules.body: Every shadow carries an offset and a blur across two layers. Blur alone is a halo and reads as decoration, not depth.

rules.name: The Dark Band Rule
rules.body: Paper shadows vanish on green. On a green band switch to --shadow-deep, which is the same two-layer shape mixed darker.

dos: Do keep the green to its three appearances: hero wash, filled header, footer.
Do let the photographs carry the colour; the interface stays cream.
Do use --bark-deep for label text sitting on an orange fill; --bark alone only reaches 4.09.
Do put a rule, plate or photograph between --paper and --cream wherever they would otherwise meet.
Do write scroll reveals as an IntersectionObserver adding a class, with the CSS transition doing the movement.
Do size photographs to their real display width; the contact photo is already close to its ceiling on a 2x screen.
donts: Don't introduce a dark green variant. One hex, three token names, deliberately.
Don't put small light text on the green; the pair is 4.08 and only clears at large sizes.
Don't use --earth (#C3A278) for anything a visitor reads. It is 2.12 on cream and exists for drawn rules only.
Don't use --leaf-bright for text. It is a decoration colour for rules and icon fills.
Don't reintroduce the salvage fonts (Bricolage Grotesque, DM Mono, Caveat Brush). They belong to the previous project.
Don't re-sort the four fruits without checking PRODUCT.md; the current calendar order rests on placeholder harvest windows.
Don't 'fix' the four signed-off contrast pairs without asking; they are a client decision, not an oversight.
